sections.section_title: 3. Pathophysiology and Molecular Basis of HNF1A-MODY
sections.description: Summarizes the biology of HNF1A, its normal function in pancreatic β‑cells, kidneys, and liver, and how loss‑of‑function mutations lead to the clinical spectrum seen in this case.
